title: feat(empty-state): draw the declared empty-state link through the action runner, and let a list page's own emptyState win (#12270)
body:
Fixes #12270
Clause-②: yes. The renderers start honouring two keys the spec declares (`emptyState.link`, and a list page's own `interfaceConfig.emptyState`), so what they draw widens. A contract review is owed before the queue.

## What this does

This is the renderer half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004 and objectstack-ai/objectstack#23005 (spec PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23098, merge `55828c5145`). It is unblocked because `main` `c5406c2` installs `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.0`. The change covers three doors, which share one piece:

- **The shared piece.** `EmptyStateLink`, in `@object-ui/components` beside `DataEmptyState`, draws the spec's `EmptyStateSchema.link` (`{ label, url }`). It follows the link as a `type: 'url'` action through the ActionRunner, so what a click opens is `classifyNavigationTarget`'s answer. It has no scheme list or URL check of its own. The `label` is a string or an inline locale map, resolved against the caller's display locale. A label that resolves to no text draws nothing.
- **Door 1: `ListView`'s empty branch** (`grid` and `gallery`). `ListEmptyState` takes `link` and draws it beside the add-record action. The spec keeps the two apart, so either, both or neither may be drawn. With no link, the DOM is unchanged.
- **Door 2: `InterfaceListPage`.** The relay is now `emptyState: cfg.emptyState ?? view.emptyState`. The page's own block wins, whole, on every visualization, because the precedence is set before the visualization is chosen. The source view's block is the fallback, as its `appearance` and `userFilters` already are.
- **Door 3: `ObjectGrid`'s authored empty state.** It draws the link in `DataEmptyState`'s action slot. The registry `inputs` description for `object-grid.emptyState` now names `link`.

Docs: the `emptyState` passages in the plugin-grid docs, README and schema reference now cover `link`. The plugin-list README gains an "Empty state" section; its typed example is checked below. Changeset: `minor` for the four packages touched.

**For the spec seat (scope addition `6132635356`):** the renderer half has landed with this PR. The follow-up is the spec seat's to file: dropping the two `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` markers, rewriting the two ledger notes, offering `interfaceConfig.emptyState` in the page form and deleting its reconciliation omit row.

## How a declared link becomes a runner navigation (measured with the real runner)

| target | under the console's provider (`onNavigate` + `onToast`) | no provider |
|---|---|---|
| in-app `/...` or `./...` | `onNavigate(url, { external: false, newTab: false })`, in place | the runner hands back `redirect`; followed with `location.assign` |
| `https://...` | `onNavigate(url, { external: true, newTab: true })` | `window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer')` |
| `mailto:` | `location.href = url`, in place; router and new tab untouched | the same |
| refused (`//host`, `thanks`, `javascript:`) | the runner's own refusal is toasted as an error; no navigation sink is touched | the refusal is logged; no navigation |

A followed link raises no success toast. The html-tier anchor and the dashboard header link raise none either.

## Deviation from the suggested route: a refused value is refused at the click, not hidden at render

The suggested route said "a refused value draws no link". Here the link is drawn, and the runner refuses it at the click and reports its refusal. Reason, measured: the spec admits at parse a url that starts with a `${...}` template, and its describe says such a url "is judged when it is clicked, after interpolation". `EmptyStateSchema.safeParse` of a link whose url is `${ctx.origin}/docs` succeeds on `18.0.0-next.0`. But `classifyNavigationTarget` answers `null` for that string before interpolation. Classifying at render would therefore hide a spec-valid link, and it would also be a second judgement beside the runner's. The pin `judges nothing at render` holds this.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **Installed shapes.** `EmptyStateSchema.link` is strict `{ label: I18nLabel, url: string }`: `url` has `min(1)` and `navigationTargetRefusal` at parse. `InterfacePageConfigSchema.emptyState` is `EmptyStateSchema.optional()`. The hold's restart probe exits 0 from `apps/console`.
2. **At `c5406c2`.** `ListView` handed `ListEmptyState` `title`, `message` and `icon` only, and `ObjectGrid` read the same three. `InterfaceListPage` relayed the source view's whole block (`emptyState: view.emptyState`) and read no `cfg.emptyState`; it did not read individual members. `classifyNavigationTarget` is the runner's one classifier (`navigateTo`, `navigateOnSuccess`).
3. **`@object-ui/types` mirrors: none needed.** `ListViewSchema['emptyState']` and `ObjectGridSchema.emptyState` both take the spec's `EmptyState` by reference. The README example (a `ListViewSchema` literal with `link: { label, url }`) compiles against the built `@object-ui/types`. The same literal with an undeclared `href` inside the link is refused with TS2353.

## Tests (real renders, real runner)

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/empty-state-link-12270.test.tsx` (14). Under a provider: in-app, https, mailto, three refused values (each compared with what a bare runner answers for the same target), a `${...}` template drawn, the label map, and absent or empty label. With no provider: redirect followed, https in a new tab, refusals logged.
- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.emptyStateLink-12270.test.tsx` (4). Grid: link beside add-record, followed in place. Gallery: https. A refused value. A control with no link.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.emptyStateLink-12270.test.tsx` (4). Through the registry and `SchemaRenderer`: in-app, https, refused, and a control with no link.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.emptyStatePrecedence-12270.test.tsx` (6). The real page renders the real `ListView`. The page's own sentence and link win on grid and on gallery, whole (the view's message does not fill the gap). The page's link is followed in place. With no page block, the view's is kept, on grid and on gallery. A control proves the gallery page mounts the gallery (cards, no table).

## Ablation (three legs)

Each leg went through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit exactly once, the blob changed, and the restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The direction was red, as predicted.

- `InterfaceListPage`: `cfg.emptyState ?? view.emptyState` became `view.emptyState`. 3 failed, 3 passed: the three page-precedence rows failed; the two fallback rows and the gallery control passed.
- `ListView`: `link={schema.emptyState?.link}` became `link={undefined}`. 3 failed, 1 passed: the control passed.
- `ObjectGrid`: the link's `action` slot was emptied. 3 failed, 1 passed: the control passed.

## Local verification (HEAD `f20667b0e`)

- Closure build: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-list^... --filter=@object-ui/plugin-grid^... --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...`, plus the two plugins: 28/28 tasks.
- Suites (run from the repo root, path-filtered, through the verify lock):
  - `packages/plugin-list/`: 131 files, 1419 tests passed.
  - `packages/plugin-grid/`: 211 files, 1920 tests passed.
  - `packages/components/`: 382 files passed, 1 skipped; 3875 tests passed, 24 skipped.
  - The 27 app-shell files that name `InterfaceListPage` or `emptyState`: 273 tests passed.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; each `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): components, plugin-list and plugin-grid all exit 0.
- app-shell `type-check`, whole package: NOT MEASURED. Reason: the verify-lock queue had not reached it after about 30 minutes, behind another seat's long locked run (`issue-11773` `final2.sh`). It is declared here as a narrowing, and CI runs the whole package. The narrowed check: `tsc` with the package's own `tsconfig.test.json`, whose `files` are the three touched app-shell files (the new test, `InterfaceListPage.tsx` and the census test). That program spans 629 workspace files, 79 of them under `app-shell/src`, and exits 0.
- eslint on the 12 touched TS files, with the repo config. The population comes from eslint's own JSON output: 12 files, 0 errors. Warning counts are unchanged on every touched source file, base vs head. The 5 warnings in the new app-shell test are the `no-explicit-any` mock pattern its siblings use. The narrowing is sound: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `project` / `projectService`), and no local rule reads another file, so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- Repo checks, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-doc-links`, `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-types`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-changeset-overwrite`. No string or i18n key was added, so the rest of the `check:i18n-*` family is not owed.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:readme-exports`. Reason: PRECONDITION NOT MET, because packages outside this closure are unbuilt (plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-markdown, plugin-timeline and others). CI builds them. The judged rows of `readme-exports` show 0 fabricated names. The new README snippet was compiled on its own (item 3 above).

## Acceptance notes

- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, in the `MEMBER_PINS` row `object-grid.emptyState`, still says "All three members the spec's strict `EmptyStateSchema` declares", but spec 18 declares four. It is mechanically green, because the check reads only that the pin file names the block and the key. The `link` member's pin is `ObjectGrid.emptyStateLink-12270.test.tsx`. This is prose drift, not filed. Carrier: whoever next edits that ledger row, for example the spec seat's follow-up above.
- The empty state, and so its link, is drawn on the `grid` and `gallery` visualizations only, as before. The other visualizations draw their own empty surfaces. That is unchanged here; the page precedence holds whatever the visualization.
- CI: `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on `main` and on every PR (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23160; consumer #12325). It is advisory and not this change's. `OAuthConsentPage.public-client-12301.test.tsx` is a known flake (#12344).
